Bug Reports: Thank you for reporting this issue — it helps us improve the platform for everyone. Our engineering team will investigate the bug you've described as a priority. Please include any relevant screenshots, error messages, and steps to reproduce the issue, and we'll keep you updated on the resolution.
Account & Access: We're sorry you're having trouble accessing your account. We can help with password resets, account recovery, permission changes, and login issues. Please verify the email address associated with your account, and we'll assist you in regaining access right away.
Billing & Subscriptions: Thank you for reaching out about your billing or subscription. We're happy to assist with plan changes, payment updates, invoice inquiries, or cancellation requests. Please share the email tied to your account, and we'll review your subscription details promptly.
Feature Requests: We truly appreciate your product feedback and feature suggestions! Our product team carefully reviews all customer requests to help shape our development roadmap. Please describe the feature you'd like to see and how it would benefit your workflow, and we'll log it for consideration.
Setup & Configuration: Welcome! We want to make sure your setup experience is smooth and successful. Our team can help with onboarding, integrations, API configuration, and initial account setup. Please describe what you're looking to configure, and we'll provide step-by-step guidance or schedule a walkthrough call.
